job.goal: 30s brand explainer + product walkthrough of the Stripe Docs developer experience

scenes.brief: Open on a title card: 'Stripe Docs' kicker, 'Build payments faster' headline, indigo accent.
Cinematic slow push-in over a developer's desk at dusk, warm screen glow, code reflected in glasses, shallow depth of field, premium fintech mood.
Abstract flowing ribbons of indigo and violet light forming an API request arc across a dark stage, particles, cinematic depth, 24fps motion-blur.
A clean isometric world of connected payment nodes lighting up in sequence across a globe, soft volumetric haze, cinematic camera orbit.
Walk through docs.stripe.com: open the API reference, navigate to Create a PaymentIntent, show the curl example and the language tabs.

voiceover.script: Stripe Docs gets developers from zero to a live payment in minutes. Search the full API reference, copy a ready-to-run request in your language, and ship with confidence. From your first PaymentIntent to production webhooks, every answer is one search away. Build payments faster, with Stripe.
